description: The organization's generations, newest first, each with its status, model, files and charge: the asset library behind generate. Filter by kind, model or status; page with before. Files are kept 30 days. Needs the key. Live from GET /v1/generations.

before.description: Only generations created before this Unix time (seconds, or the ms next_before of the last page).
